theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_bml_tilt_pointwise_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (β : Covector (Euclid P) 2), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → (∀ v : Fin 2 → Euclid P, β v = inner ℝ a (v 0) * inner ℝ e (v 1) - inner ℝ a (v 1) * inner ℝ e (v 0)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection x = x) → (∀ x : Euclid P, 0 < inner ℝ x a → ‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, |R.orient x β| ≤ 1 ∧ (0 < inner ℝ x a → 1 - 2 * (1 - |R.orient x β|) ≤ ‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2)
